title: ononis pendula var. penduliflora
intro: Ononis pendula var. penduliflora, commonly known as the pendulous sainfoin or sainfoin, is a perennial legume plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the relief of gastrointestinal issues and the alleviation of respiratory problems. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents present in O. pendula var. penduliflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
